verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI ships an async-first crawler (AsyncWebCrawler/arun) and claims parallel crawling. It also documents multi-URL batch configuration and browser-pool monitoring. Reliability features such as automatic retry with proxy fallback and resume_state crash recovery support long-running, large-scale jobs. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented batch-crawl API with concurrency/rate-limit controls, evidence of throughput at the thousands-of-URLs scale, and independent hands-on corroboration of batch performance.
